messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE: Potential KV-cache blowup + continuous-batching regression causing autoscale thrash. Sev2. Root TS: 1752003333. Paging #eng-oncall and SRE rotation.

maria: ack — I'm oncall. Pulling up dashboards.

tim: oncall handover in ~5m, I'll monitor infra metrics while you dig.

alex: saw batch_size distribution spike ~30m ago. avg_batch_size jumped to ~60, tail to 128. KV cache entries shot up.

sudha: I rolled runtime change to enable aggressive_prefix_merging on canary ~35m ago (config flip).

jen: CS reported latency spikes and two customer alerts. Ticket #4129 opened.

maria: symptoms: OOMKilled pods, high GC, huge mem-rss. HPA started oscillating 6 -> 18 -> 7 in ~12m. p50 latency 120ms -> 600ms.

alex: logs (excerpt):
```
[2025-03-15T10:05:12Z] runtime: cache_entries=1.2M mem_bytes=78.5GB batch_avg=62
[2025-03-15T10:06:03Z] kubelet: container runtime OOMKilled pid=2345
[2025-03-15T10:07:40Z] metrics: pod_count=18 hpa_event=scale_up reason=batch_size_spike
```

maria: immediate plan: 1) disable the aggressive prefix-merge flag (rollback canary/cut hotfix) 2) patch HPA to reduce thrash (min/max, stabilization window) 3) add kv warmup and restart in staggered batches 4) observe.

sudha: applying hotfix to configmap now.

sudha: running commands:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime CONTINUOUS_BATCHING_PREFIX_MERGE=false --record
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sudha: rollout/runtime v2025.03.15-hotfix (canary->prod).

tim: patching HPA to add stabilization and sane min/max.
```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4,"maxReplicas":12,"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":60},"scaleUp":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":30}}}}'
```

oncall-bot: Suppressing alert noise for 15m while mitigation ongoing. Please post updates here.

maria: also adding a runtime warmup flag to avoid cold-start cache blowups; will restart 20% at a time.

sudha: added flag --kv-warmup=1000 to container args and restarted pods in 5 waves (20% each).

alex: quick metrics check after hotfix: avg_batch_size -> 8, mem usage per pod -> ~12GB, no new OOMs; HPA leveling at 6 pods.

jen: CS update: notified two affected customers, offered credits; ticket #4129 updated with incident summary.

maria: leaving a short runbook excerpt in thread:
- rollback aggressive prefix merging until perf tests added
- add e2e perf test for continuous batching and cache growth
- implement circuit breaker limiting batch_size per-request
- tune HPA thresholds and stabilization windows for batch-driven workload
- add warmup on pod start to pre-seed small prefixes

tim: will follow up with an HPA autoscaler policy doc PR. Oncall handover to alex in ~10m — I'll stay available for 15 more.

alex: taking over incident. Adding notes to #incidents and will tidy postmortem. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: runtime v2025.03.15-hotfix -> success.

maria: post-incident check: monitoring shows no recurrence in last 25m; keeping paged alerts escalations at Sev2 for 1 hour as precaution. Filing postmortem with action items.

maria: tl;dr: change in continuous-batching config caused prefix merging to combine large prefixes resulting in large batches and KV-cache explosion, which drove memory pressure and autoscaler thrash. Hotfix disabled feature, added warmup, and hardened HPA.

jen: marking CS tickets resolved pending customer confirmation.

maria: thanks all — great coordination. :raised_hands:
